questions.question: Can missing verdict-critical evidence become PASS?
questions.context: Missing required evidence cannot establish PASS.

questions.question: Can observer failure be mistaken for product failure?
questions.context: The verifier must distinguish observer/infrastructure failure from a supported product violation.

questions.question: Can nondeterminism create a false divergence?
questions.context: Uncontrolled nondeterminism can; stability policy and equivalent inputs bound this risk, not exhaustively eliminate it.

questions.question: Can baseline poisoning hide a regression?
questions.context: A poisoned trusted baseline can hide a regression; candidates cannot auto-update it.

questions.question: Can the agent read verifier secrets/private controller material?
questions.context: An unrestricted same-user host agent can. An isolated Docker target must not receive controller material; the public fixture is not secret.

questions.question: Is a failure reproducible from recorded experiment inputs?
questions.context: Within recorded scope when replay is available; otherwise replayability must explicitly be unavailable with a reason. Not universal paired replay.

claim_boundary: Bounded external operator sample only: no universal usability or compatibility, exhaustive verifier correctness, same-user host secrecy, statistically representative adoption, independent correctness labels, publisher authentication, or market demand. Does not override V100. Public archetypes do not establish third-party project compatibility. Self-attestation is not cryptographic identity proof. Hashes are integrity identifiers, not signatures.
